description: Source code for Samsung's OMX video encoder component (SEC_OMX_Venc.c), including buffer management, parameter handling, and component initialization for video encoding.

methods.name: SEC_UpdateFrameSize
methods.description: Updates output port frame size and buffer size based on input port parameters.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_UseBuffer
methods.description: Handles user-allocated buffer for a specified port.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_AllocateBuffer
methods.description: Allocates buffer memory for a specified port.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_FreeBuffer
methods.description: Frees buffer memory for a specified port.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_ComponentTunnelRequest
methods.description: Handles tunnel setup requests; unsupported in this implementation.

methods.name: SEC_Check_BufferProcess_State
methods.description: Checks if component is in a state suitable for buffer processing.

methods.name: SEC_InputBufferReturn
methods.description: Returns input buffer to the component, handling mark and state updates.

methods.name: SEC_OutputBufferReturn
methods.description: Returns output buffer to the component, handling mark and state updates.

methods.name: SEC_OutputBufferGetQueue
methods.description: Retrieves an output buffer from the queue.

methods.name: SEC_Preprocessor_InputData
methods.description: Prepares input data, handling EOF and buffer copying.

methods.name: SEC_Postprocess_OutputData
methods.description: Processes output data, copying to output buffer and handling EOS.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_BufferProcess
methods.description: Main buffer processing loop, managing input/output buffers and encoding.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_VideoEncodeComponentInit
methods.description: Initializes the video encoder component, setting up ports and function pointers.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_VideoEncodeComponentDeinit
methods.description: Deinitializes the component, freeing allocated resources.
